name: Merfolk and wizards
description: Merfolk and Wizards in blue, green and red: card draw, counterspells, creatures that are hard to block and spells that reward casting instants.

cards.name: Maerith, Current-Speaker
cards.rule_text:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on target Merfolk or Wizard you control.
Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
cards.flavor_text: "Listen to the water. It always knows the way through."

cards.name: Calder Vash, Storm-Lettered
cards.rule_text:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
At the beginning of your end step, if you've cast two or more instant and/or sorcery spells this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Reefcaller Hierophant
cards.rule_text:
Other Merfolk and Wizards you control get +1/+1.
Whenever you cast an instant spell, scry 1.
cards.flavor_text: Her call carries from the deepest trench to the highest tower.

cards.name: Shoalborn Apprentice
cards.rule_text: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Kelpbed Forager
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, scry 1.
{T}: Add {G} or {U}.
cards.flavor_text: The tide brings gifts to those who wait at the shore.

cards.name: Cinderscript Novice
cards.rule_text:
Prowess
When CARDNAME enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Riptide Interrupter
cards.rule_text:
Flash
When CARDNAME enters, counter up to one target spell unless its controller pays {2}.

cards.name: Brinedeep Pathfinder
Emberquill Scholar
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage equal to the number of Wizards you control to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.

cards.name: Deepwater Lorekeeper
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
cards.flavor_text: What sinks is never lost. It is only waiting to be read.

cards.name: Reedmarsh Wayfinder
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Glyphstorm Archmage
cards.rule_text:
Ward {2}
Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.flavor_text: Every word she speaks, the storm repeats.

cards.name: Tidebreaker Matriarch
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk you control. Merfolk you control can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Refusal of the Shoals
cards.rule_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {X}, where X is the number of Merfolk and/or Wizards you control.

cards.name: Lessons of the Undertow
cards.rule_text: Draw two cards. If you've cast another instant or sorcery spell this turn, draw three cards instead.
cards.flavor_text: The deep teaches patience first, and everything else after.

cards.name: Arcing Glyphfire
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. If you control a Wizard, CARDNAME deals 3 damage instead.

cards.name: Swell of the Shallows
cards.rule_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Merfolk and each Wizard you control. Those creatures gain hexproof until end of turn.

cards.name: Codex of the Drowned Spires
cards.rule_text:
Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast as long as you control a Wizard.
{2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Hidden Reef Passage
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}{U}, {T}: Target Merfolk or Wizard you control can't be blocked this turn.
